from pathlib import Path

import hashlib,json,resource,signal,sys,time

import classification_plane_m2_eight_hf_review as Q
H=Q.H;ck=Q.ck;ROOT=Path.cwd();COORDS=('h','x','y','z','w')
JOB=ROOT/'research/classification/jobs/rank_one_five_quadratic_support_separate_review.json'
INPUT=ROOT/'research/classification/inputs/rank_one_five_quadratic_support_separate_review_caller_20261108.json'

started=time.monotonic();resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(3072*1024**2,)*2);signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,lambda a,b:(_ for _ in ()).throw(TimeoutError('ONE five fixed quadratic-support replay180sec')));signal.alarm(180)
load=lambda path:json.loads((ROOT/path).read_text())
packet=load('reports/CLASSIFICATION_RANK_ONE_FIVE_GENUINE_QUADRATIC_SUPPORT_20261108.json')
specs=load('research/classification/inputs/rank_one_five_quadratic_canonical_sources_20261108.json')['families']
oldpeer=load('reports/CLASSIFICATION_RANK_ONE_LONG_NINE_AMBIENT_SEPARATE_REVIEW_20261108.json');ck(oldpeer['status'],'PASS','already independent full D/M/point9')
ck([s['id']for s in specs],['M1','M11','B1','B3','V1'],'same five only')
records=[]
def eye(n):return [[F(i==j)for j in range(n)]for i in range(n)]
def zero(m,n):return [[F(0)]*n for _ in range(m)]
def pick(A,rr,cc):return [[A[i][j]for j in cc]for i in rr]
def addm(A,B,sign=1):return [[a+sign*b for a,b in zip(r,s)]for r,s in zip(A,B)]
def mons(n,d):return [tuple(c.count(i)for i in range(n))for c in combinations_with_replacement(range(n),d)]
def paramdiff(P,k):
 out={}
 for e,c in P.items():
  if e[k]:ee=list(e);ee[k]-=1;out[tuple(ee)]=c*e[k]
 return out
for spec,rec in zip(specs,packet['cases']):
 tick=time.monotonic();name=spec['id'];ck(rec['id'],name,'same literal case');ck(rec['source_spec'],spec,'whole canonical source definition')
 ck(hashlib.sha256((ROOT/spec['original_immutable_report_path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),spec['original_report_sha256'],'original ambient bytes')
 old=load(spec['original_immutable_report_path'])['cases'][spec['original_case_index']];ck(old['id'],name,'same old point')
 params=tuple(spec['canonical_parameter_order']);R=Q.LaurentRing(params,COORDS);p=R.parse;point=spec['point_substitution'];scale=F(spec['integer_scale'])
 U=list(map(p,spec['U']));hh=p(spec['H']);ff=p(spec['F']);dd=R.add(R.derivative(U[0],3),R.derivative(U[1],4));ck(p(spec['g']),{},'same gzero');ck(R.add(R.mul(U[0],R.derivative(hh,3)),R.mul(U[1],R.derivative(hh,4)),hh),{},'WHOLE source UH+H=0')
 rr=p('y-x**2/2');Paff={(1,2):R.scale(R.add(ff,R.mul(R.add(dd,p('1')),rr)),-1),(1,3):U[0],(1,4):U[1],(2,3):R.add(R.mul(p('x'),U[0]),R.derivative(hh,4)),(2,4):R.add(R.mul(p('x'),U[1]),R.scale(R.derivative(hh,3),-1))}
 def homogeneous(P):
  out={}
  for e,c in P.items():
   ex=e[R.n:];assert ex[0]==0 and sum(ex)<=2
   ee=e[:R.n]+(2-sum(ex),)+ex[1:];out[ee]=out.get(ee,F(0))+scale*c
  return {e:c for e,c in out.items()if c}
 P=Q.skew(R,{ij:homogeneous(Paff.get(ij,{}))for ij in Q.PAIRS})
 assert not any(Q.strict(R,P).values()),'WHOLE canonical source strict10';assert not any(Q.jac(R,P).values()),'WHOLE canonical source350'
 P0=H.skew({ij:Q.evaluate(R,P[ij],point)for ij in Q.PAIRS});ck(H.vector(P0),list(map(F,old['full150_point'])),'sourcepoint is original150')
 pc=[]
 for k in range(len(params)):
  deriv=H.skew({ij:Q.evaluate(R,paramdiff(P[ij],k),point)for ij in Q.PAIRS});pc.append(H.vector(deriv))
 CP=H.transpose(pc);ck(CP,Q.sparsemat(rec['all_canonical_parameter_directions150']),'all canonical actual derivative entries')
 D=Q.sparsemat(old['complete_sparse_matrices']['D350x150']);M=Q.sparsemat(old['complete_sparse_matrices']['Euler_GL_scalar150x51']);dc=old['certificates']['D350x150'];K,old_det=Q.cert(D,dc);free=dc['free_columns'];rank=dc['rank'];ck(rank,spec['expected_D_rank'],'same old D rank')
 FF=[a+b for a,b in zip(M,CP)];ck(FF,Q.sparsemat(rec['all_actual_tangent_F']),'full F group51+whole parameters');ck(Q.mm(D,FF),zero(350,len(FF[0])),'all original DF zero')
 minor=rec['actual_F50_minor'];fr,fc=minor['rows'],minor['columns'];assert len(fr)==len(fc)==50 and len(set(fr))==len(set(fc))==50
 fdet=H.det(pick(FF,fr,fc));ck(fdet,F(minor['determinant']),'same F50 selected determinant');assert fdet
 F50=pick(FF,range(150),fc);ni=rec['normal_kernel_column_indices'];dn=rec['normal_dimension'];ck(dn,150-rank-50,'true normal dimension');ck(dn,spec['expected_true_normal_dimension'],'same predeclared true normal dimension');assert len(set(ni))==len(ni)==dn
 N=pick(K,range(150),ni);ck(N,Q.sparsemat(rec['full_true_normal150_by_d']),'all true normals are old complete kernel columns')
 cuts=Q.sparsemat(rec['actual50_linear_cuts']);ck(Q.mm(cuts,F50),eye(50),'actual cut F50 identity');ck(Q.mm(cuts,N),zero(50,dn),'actual cut true N zero')
 I,J=dc['minor_rows'],dc['minor_columns'];ck(I,rec['old_implicit_equation_rows'],'same selected equations');ck(J,rec['old_coordinate_U_columns'],'same selected coordinate U');ck(old_det,rec['old_implicit_nonzero_minor'],'same old nonzero implicit determinant');ck(pick(cuts,range(50),J),zero(50,rank),'actual cut coordinate U zero')
 ck(Q.mm(F50,Q.mm(cuts,FF)),FF,'all F directions in actual F50 span: rank exactly50')
 ck(rec['rank_F'],50,'actual rank50');assert 50+dn+rank==150
 ncols=H.transpose(N);tensors=[];diagonal=[]
 for v in ncols:
  T=H.skew({ij:{e:c for(ijj,e),c in zip(H.COLS,v)if ijj==ij and c}for ij in Q.PAIRS});tensors.append(T);diagonal.append(H.jvector(H.jac(T)))
 qcols=[]
 for i in range(dn):
  for j in range(i,dn):
   if i==j:qcols.append(diagonal[i])
   else:qcols.append([a-b-c for a,b,c in zip(H.jvector(H.jac(H.plus(tensors[i],tensors[j]))),diagonal[i],diagonal[j])])
 qm=mons(dn,2);ck([list(e)for e in qm],rec['all_quadratic_normal_monomial_order'],'all quadratic normal monomials');QQ=H.transpose(qcols);ck(QQ,Q.sparsemat(rec['all350_normal_quadratic_coefficients']),'independently reconstructed all350 quadratic coefficients')
 corr=Q.sparsemat(rec['full_implicit_quadratic_correction_U']);ck(addm(Q.mm(pick(D,I,J),corr),pick(QQ,I,range(len(qm)))),zero(rank,len(qm)),'unique implicit quadratic correction solves ALL selected rows')
 CC=addm(QQ,Q.mm(pick(D,range(350),J),corr));ck(CC,Q.sparsemat(rec['all350_genuine_cokernel_quadratic_coefficients']),'all350 genuine cokernel coefficients');ck(pick(CC,I,range(len(qm))),zero(rank,len(qm)),'selected corrected rows vanish')
 gi=rec['quadratic_generator_original_row_indices'];G=pick(CC,gi,range(len(qm)));ck(G,Q.sparsemat(rec['quadratic_generators_coefficients']),'selected full cokernel basis generators');assert len(H.rref(G)[1])==len(gi)
 decomp=Q.sparsemat(rec['all350_rows_decomposition_in_generators']);ck(Q.mm(decomp,G),CC,'every350 row in full generator span')
 functionals=Q.sparsemat(rec['true_cokernel_functional_old_selected_coefficients']);ck(addm(pick(D,gi,range(150)),Q.mm(functionals,pick(D,I,range(150))),-1),zero(len(gi),150),'TRUE functional kills ALL150 D columns');ck(addm(pick(QQ,gi,range(len(qm))),Q.mm(functionals,pick(QQ,I,range(len(qm)))),-1),G,'true functional reconstructs ALL quadratic initial generators')
 deg=dn+1;ck(deg,rec['fixed_Macaulay_degree'],'fixed d+1 degree no adaptation');md=mons(dn,deg);mults=mons(dn,deg-2);labels=[{'generator_index':i,'multiplier_exponent':list(e)}for i in range(len(G))for e in mults]
 ck([list(e)for e in md],rec['Macaulay_row_monomials'],'all degree N monomials');ck(labels,rec['Macaulay_column_labels'],'every allowed quadratic multiplier')
 pos={e:i for i,e in enumerate(md)};MAC=zero(len(md),len(labels))
 for k,label in enumerate(labels):
  for e,c in zip(qm,G[label['generator_index']]):
   ee=tuple(a+b for a,b in zip(e,label['multiplier_exponent']));MAC[pos[ee]][k]+=c
 ck(MAC,Q.sparsemat(rec['full_Macaulay_coefficient_matrix']),'entire fixed Macaulay matrix');mr=len(H.rref(MAC)[1]);ck(mr,rec['Macaulay_rank'],'exact fixed Macaulay rank');primary=mr==len(md);ck(primary,rec['quadratic_ideal_m_primary'],'whole quadratic m-primary classification')
 if primary:
  lifts=Q.sparsemat(rec['all_degree_N_monomial_membership_lifts']);ck(Q.mm(MAC,lifts),eye(len(md)),'ALL degreeN monomial exact membership lifts');ck(rec['nonprimary_degree_N_left_witness'],None,'no failed witness positive')
 else:
  witness=list(map(F,rec['nonprimary_degree_N_left_witness']));assert any(witness);ck(Q.mm([witness],MAC),zero(1,len(labels)),'nonprimary fixed-degree annihilator');ck(rec['all_degree_N_monomial_membership_lifts'],None,'no invented positive membership')
 if name=='M1':
  assert all(not c for row in G for e,c in zip(qm,row)if e[2]==0);assert len(G)==3 and len(H.rref(G)[1])==3;geometry='I2=t2*(t0,t1,t2), radical plane t2=0; actual higher support unresolved'
 elif name=='M11':
  assert len(G)==1;a,b,c=G[0];assert b*b-4*a*c;geometry='I2 is one nondegenerate binary quadratic, two complex lines; actual higher support unresolved'
 else:geometry='quadratic m-primary; actual100slice support zero; componenthood only, NO smoothness or local uniqueness'
 if name=='B3':ck(G,[[F(-1,2)]],'exact B3 initial -t0^2/2')
 if name=='V1':ck(G,[[F(-12)]],'exact V1 initial -12t0^2')
 records.append({'id':name,'whole_canonical_source_and_all_parameter_derivatives_reconstructed':True,'old_same_point_D_M_complete_kernel_bound_by_prior_independent9':True,'actual_F_rank50_and_all_DF_zero':True,'F50_selected_determinant':str(fdet),'true_normal_dimension':dn,'full_actual_cut_and_150_direct_sum_verified':True,'all350_quadratic_vectors_unique_U_corrections_cokernel_and_fullD_functionals_verified':True,'all350_cokernel_rows_decomposition_verified':True,'fixed_Macaulay_degree':deg,'Macaulay_rank':mr,'Macaulay_rows':len(md),'m_primary':primary,'all_degree_N_membership_lifts_or_nonzero_left_witness_verified':True,'geometric_scope':geometry,'seconds':time.monotonic()-tick});print(name,'genuine quadratic support independent PASS',mr,len(md),records[-1]['seconds'],flush=True)
signal.alarm(0)
